newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-IAMA lowers Primac acceptance level.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-IAMA lowers Primac acceptance level.

text.p: IAMA Ltd said on Friday it had reduced the minimum acceptance condition in its offer document for pastoral company Primac Holdings Ltd to 50.1 percent from 90 percent.

The company said in its Part A takeover document that this was the only alteration in its previously announced nine-for-10 share swap offer. IAMA said the offer would be dispatched in two weeks and is proposed to stay open for one month.
Directors of Primac have described the bid as inadequate and recommended that shareholders take no action.
